description: This file defines the custom exception class 'LoraProviderDownlinkException' used for error handling within the LoRa provider downlink component of the Eclipse Hono project. It extends RuntimeException and provides constructors for message-only and message-plus-cause instantiations.

classes.name: LoraProviderDownlinkException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception used to indicate errors during processing of downlink messages in the LoRa provider module.

methods.name: LoraProviderDownlinkException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with an error message.

methods.name: LoraProviderDownlinkException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with an error message and a cause.
